message:

W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 235, "amount_cents": 1660}, {"order_id": 234, "amount_cents": 4004}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 231, "amount_cents": 17910, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (failed 3 attempts; list_refunds confirms it is not recorded)"}], "status": "partial: 2 of 3 refunds applied"}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Incomplete refunds: order 231 refund of 17910 cents failed three times due to disk I/O error; W2 reports list_refunds confirmed it was not recorded. Batch requires human review before any payouts.

reply.thought: W2's detailed report confirms a concrete problem: the refund for order 231 was not recorded after three failed attempts, so refunds were not completed as intended. I must hold the batch before recording any payouts.
